title: PAH-OMC-004 explicit anchor generator-row replay
question: Does the actual PAH midpoint generator have identical rows on the n=1 and n=2 anchor patches of the genuine diagonal-incidence successor for every finite Q=0 local state, while retaining the n=0 boundary defect?
method: Pin the immutable PAH-001 bytes, the separately hashed PAH-OMC-004 successor, and a new PAH-OMC-004-GEN-001 verification sidecar; do not edit any parent.
Rebuild the two oriented triangle terms, aperture onsite and edge terms, and the unchanged midpoint rate from the displayed PAH functional on the four-vertex anchor patch.
Enumerate all 2^4 aperture assignments and 2^5 Z_2 link assignments at Q=0, retaining the exact tuple (state, direction, Delta F, mobility^2, observable increment, rate exponent).

Construct the declared G_1 and G_2 strip incidence signatures and verify that the anchor interaction closure and affected term support are identical; remote terms cancel under an anchor aperture flip.
Recompute the preceding square boundary with diagonal link zero and one, preserving the exact nonzero defect instead of averaging, fitting or adding a term.
Run primary, non-importing independent, hostile mutation, integrated and Lean lanes; keep the result finite/local and claim-nonbearing.
finding: The exact PAH generator row for the anchor-aperture cylinder agrees between G_1 and G_2 for all 512 binary Q=0 patch states. The primary lane passes 30/30, the non-importing independent lane passes 14/14, hostile review rejects 16/16 mutations, the integrated verifier passes 28/28, and Lean R484 compiles. The n=0 square-to-split boundary remains Delta F values 1/8, 1/4 and -55/36 with hidden diagonal defect 16/9.
decision_reason: R-483 supplied a local geometric incidence family but did not explicitly enumerate the actual PAH generator rows. This sidecar closes that reproducibility gap on the declared anchor cylinder without changing PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-004. It is a finite Q=0 local check only; the active gate and Stage-2 evidence boundary remain unchanged.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite/local structural verification for PAH-OMC-004. The 512-state enumeration is not a global all-cylinder theorem, a source-authorized nonzero-Q result, a volume-uniform estimate, a common infinite-volume dynamics theorem, an ordered limit or a physical interpretation.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AND BLOCKED: nonzero-Q transport, common infinite-volume algebra and uniform estimates are missing.
